offset_dependency_guard_S4_S5.rule: audit the COMPLETE design [offset | nuisance | candidate]; reject exact or near-exact affine functions of the offset, exact functions of the incumbent projection, and candidate pairs that jointly reconstruct the offset; own_est + opp_est == 2*projected, so the pair may not enter beside the offset — a single preregistered nonredundant contrast (own-opp) is admissible with fold-local full rank; recalibration is its own hypothesis family and may not hide inside a substantive arm

postgame_surrogate_guard_S1.proven: unlagged minutes FAILS; minutes/5 FAILS; renames, affine and nonlinear injective transforms of current-game duration FAIL; correctly lagged prior-game duration PASSES all cutoff checks (P22 TESTS, verified)
postgame_surrogate_guard_S1.rule: no current-game outcome-derived column may enter a prediction frame; history requires a documented lag of >=1 completed prior game with source keys and timestamps preceding the cutoff; same-game joins fail closed; receipts record the lag transformation

primary_before_secondary_P28.rule: a candidate passes its registered PRIMARY possession-target gate before it may enter the frozen turnover scorer; the primary verdict is frozen, content-addressed, before any downstream number is computed; improving downstream turnover MAE while worsening the primary target FAILS; no credit for arbitraging the raw/regulation-equivalent scorer mismatch

core_rules: for every arm the matched null holds identical rows, target, folds, weights, offset, fallback machinery, nuisance terms and lower-order structural terms, and excludes ONLY the treatment mechanism under test

calibration-only arm: the null fixes the tested parameter at its incumbent value (slope 1; the preregistered lower-order intercept structure); the calibration family carries its own nested null and its own multiplicity accounting
substantive-feature arm: K0 contains every non-substantive structural degree of freedom granted to the candidate; tier interactions require lower-order tier main effects in K0
no arm receives credit for free re-centring, changed fallback, or a more flexible estimator; K0_FLAT is diagnostic only

tier support constraint (P27, measured): under a 10-cluster support floor NO training fold supports the full tier ladder of V2's single control — a per-arm K0 must respect fold-local support or declare the preregistered active-set rule

D005_FEATURE_GATE_CANNOT_ENFORCE_THE_PRO.question: P22 and P29 independently report that feature_gate.audit passes columns the ruling prohibits. Verified?
D005_FEATURE_GATE_CANNOT_ENFORCE_THE_PRO.ruling: VERIFIED BY THE COORDINATOR, from scratch, on synthetic data, without reusing either node's code. Three reproductions, each returning passed=True with an EMPTY findings list: (1) a column that is exactly 5x game duration, the master_team.minutes shape, from which game_minutes is recoverable by division; (2) raw game_minutes itself, the literally prohibited column; (3) a 100 percent missing column. The third has a located cause: feature_gate.py line 152, 'if n_miss == 0 or n_miss == len(miss): continue', skips the informative-missingness branch entirely for a fully missing column, so any feature whose coverage begins mid-history passes silently on every earlier fold. Independently corroborated by U10 from the product lane, which measured 0 occurrences of game_minutes or PROHIBIT across feature_gate.py's 208 lines. CONSEQUENCE: the prohibition on current-game duration entering the prediction path is enforced NOWHERE in shared code and has rested entirely on call-site discipline. This is NOT authorisation to edit feature_gate.py -- it is confirmation that the task-specific wrappers from P22, P25 and P27 are the correct and necessary remedy, and it must be recorded in EVIDENCE_PACKET_V3 as a correction to the enforcement claim, not merely as a note.

D006_FOLD_COUNT_IS_FIVE.authority: RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1 precedence -- where the contract and a shared implementation appear to disagree about what a check does, the IMPLEMENTATION governs; GRAPH_POLICY.md s1 -- frozen bytes govern over prose
D006_FOLD_COUNT_IS_FIVE.question: P27 halted on an inference-structure ambiguity: EVIDENCE_PACKET_V2.inference_specification.fold_construction reads 'chronological, nested by season', which admits a six-fold season-block reading and a five-fold expanding-window reading. Which governs?
D006_FOLD_COUNT_IS_FIVE.ruling: FIVE FOLDS. The implementation governs over ambiguous prose, and it is not ambiguous: possession_features.chronological_folds builds one fold per season having at least one strictly earlier season. The coordinator ran it against the live universe and it returns exactly five -- train_lt_2022 (410 train / 478 test), train_lt_2023 (888/520), train_lt_2024 (1408/524), train_lt_2025 (1932/620), train_lt_2026 (2552/430) -- over 2,982 rows and 1,491 clusters across seasons 2021-2026. P22 independently enumerated the same five fold ids with the same five training-row counts while working on an unrelated mandate, which is corroboration from a source that was not asked the question. The packet's prose DESCRIBES this function; it does not compete with it. Note for V3: S7's packet measurement is tabulated by SEASON across six seasons, not by fold across six folds. 'Identically zero in four of six chronological folds' is a statement about seasons and must be restated in fold terms.

D007_K0_MATCHED_SUPERSEDES_THE_PACKET_CO.authority: directive S6/S9 binding rulings; V2_STOP_CONDITION S9; GRAPH_POLICY.md s1; the packet is frozen and is not edited
D007_K0_MATCHED_SUPERSEDES_THE_PACKET_CO.question: P26 halts because making K0_MATCHED a map keyed by arm_id supersedes the single control object in the frozen EVIDENCE_PACKET_V2.control_specification, and says no arm may be adjudicated while two frozen documents disagree. Supersede, or reject the contract?
D007_K0_MATCHED_SUPERSEDES_THE_PACKET_CO.ruling: SUPERSEDE, PROSPECTIVELY, AND RECORD IT IN V3 -- do not edit V2. The per-arm requirement is not this node's invention: it is the standing S6 ruling, and it was independently re-derived by the V2 estimator source as S9 from a different direction (a uniform team-identity-permutation control silently passes a level-transport arm, because permuting team identities does not destroy a league-level time signal). Two independent derivations of the same structural requirement is the strongest evidence this wave produced. P26 is RIGHT that the disagreement must not be left implicit -- that is why it halted, and halting was correct. The resolution is the mechanism the program already has: V2 stays frozen and byte-identical as a historical record, and EVIDENCE_PACKET_V3 carries an explicit, itemised supersession of control_specification with both readings preserved. No arm is adjudicated before V3 is frozen, so nothing is adjudicated against a superseded control. P27's SC-1 makes this urgent rather than academic: under a 10-cluster support floor NO training fold supports the full tier ladder the packet's single control requires, so the packet's control_specification is not merely superseded on design grounds, it is UNESTIMABLE as written.

D008_D10_MANUFACTURED_A_NEGATIVE.authority: standing rules 6 and 7; RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1 Phase 2.1 -- the coordinator independently verifies, an agent report identifies where to look and is not itself evidence
D008_D10_MANUFACTURED_A_NEGATIVE.question: D10 reports the coaching family ABSENT with 0 coverage and evidence 'none found in the repository'. D12, running concurrently and independently, reports event-dated coaching records in data/injury_history/injury_history.csv. Which is right?
D008_D10_MANUFACTURED_A_NEGATIVE.ruling: D12 IS RIGHT; D10 FAILS. Verified by the coordinator directly against the bytes: injury_history.csv carries 49 front_office rows including dated coaching changes -- 2021-05-03 ATL 'Nicki Collen resigns as Head Coach for Atlanta Dream' and 'The Atlanta Dream hired Mike Peterson as Interim Head Coach'. D10's ABSENT verdict is a MANUFACTURED NEGATIVE: standing rule 7 violated in its mirror form, and rule 6 too, since the verdict rests on a stated grep result that does not match what the grep returns. The correct status is PRESENT_RETROSPECTIVE / CUTOFF_UNPROVEN. NOTE AGAINST MYSELF: my own first check of the same file ALSO returned a false negative, silently, because the pyarrow-backed column defeated the string search. The negative is easy to manufacture by accident, which is precisely why two independent nodes touching the same bytes is worth its cost. The 2,930 rows matching 'coach' are mostly COACH'S DECISION in missed_game_other and are NOT coaching identity; the signal is the 49 front_office rows. D12's own coverage figures (38 of 76 team-seasons, 1,570 of 2,982 rows) were NOT re-derived by the coordinator and are relayed.

D009_TWO_CUTOFF_STANDARDS_BOTH_CARRIED.authority: Stage 1B accepted ruling and its stated scope; GRAPH_POLICY.md s5 -- a deterministic consequence of an already accepted ruling is coordinator-decidable; directive s14 -- no outcome has been observed, so no gate is being weakened after the fact
D009_TWO_CUTOFF_STANDARDS_BOTH_CARRIED.question: D10 halts on this: is 'validated construction order' the same cutoff-validity standard as 'timestamped observation'? Under the stricter rule, the four incumbent-equivalent possession features (pace_gap, pace_evidence_depth, opp_pace_evidence_depth, is_playoff_game) are all CUTOFF_UNPROVEN, because team_possession_prior_v1.parquet carries no per-row capture timestamp.
D009_TWO_CUTOFF_STANDARDS_BOTH_CARRIED.ruling: THEY ARE NOT THE SAME STANDARD, AND V3 CARRIES BOTH. D10 is right to refuse to pick one, and right that this touches the historical feature evidence. But it is not new information -- it is the Stage 1B scoped limitation restated in the data lane's vocabulary. TEAM_POSSESSION_PRODUCER_PROVENANCE_v2.2 is already SCIENTIFICALLY_ACCEPTED_WITH_SCOPED_LIMITATIONS, scoped to the exact receipted possession-feature path, and that acceptance already states it does NOT establish independent proof of cutoff validity. So the program has both accepted the receipted path and recorded that the stronger proof is absent. RULING, prospective: (1) the Stage 1B scoped acceptance continues to govern the receipted incumbent-equivalent path -- this node does not supersede an accepted scientific ruling; (2) the stricter timestamped-observation standard governs NEW fields entering the candidate universe, which is what D10 was chartered to assess; (3) V3 names both standards explicitly, records which fields sit under which, and does NOT silently merge them. Adopting the strict standard universally would render the frozen operational incumbent's own feature set inadmissible, which no evidence in this wave supports -- D10 demonstrated a weaker proof standard, not leakage.

D010_UNIVERSE_EXCLUDES_2021_OPENING_DAY.authority: measured directly from possessions_raw_v2.parquet against possession_features.load_universe()
D010_UNIVERSE_EXCLUDES_2021_OPENING_DAY.question: D10 reports the possession universe excludes the 2021 opening day entirely, so every coverage figure is computed with the hardest cold-start day already removed. True?
D010_UNIVERSE_EXCLUDES_2021_OPENING_DAY.ruling: CONFIRMED EXACTLY, by the coordinator. The possessions artifact holds 1,495 games; the universe holds 1,491. The four missing game_ids are 1022100001, 1022100002, 1022100003 and 1022100004, and all four are dated 2021-05-14 -- the opening day of the first season in the archive, where the pace producer has no prior-games evidence at all. This resolves the packet's own unexplained '1491 vs 1495' nit, which sat three lines apart in V2 over different universes and was flagged as an observation rather than diagnosed. CONSEQUENCE, which V3 must carry: every cold-start coverage figure computed on this universe is FLATTERED BY CONSTRUCTION, because the single hardest cold-start day is already removed before counting. Any arm whose mechanism is cold-start behaviour is being evaluated on a universe that excludes the worst cold-start case it exists to handle.

D011_SEAL_IS_OBFUSCATION_NOT_BLINDING.authority: GRAPH_POLICY.md s7 -- blinding; acceptance criteria are met or they are not
D011_SEAL_IS_OBFUSCATION_NOT_BLINDING.question: I11's verifier reconstructed the full plaintext of both sealed payloads in about ten lines using only DOMAIN, manifest_digest and the payload name. Is the blinding infrastructure fit for P38_BLINDED_FIT?
D011_SEAL_IS_OBFUSCATION_NOT_BLINDING.ruling: NOT FIT AS BUILT, and this matters more than its Severity C lane suggests. The seal is PUBLIC-KEYED OBFUSCATION, not blinding: the read trap is armed only while the SealedWriter context is open, and after finalize() the writing process can read the directory unobstructed. I11 is recorded PASS_WITH_DEFECTS because its manifest binding is sound and useful, but the acceptance criterion 'a sealed directory cannot be read by the writing process' is NOT met as worded and must not be cited as met. CONSEQUENCE: P38_BLINDED_FIT may not rely on this mechanism for its seal. Blinding for the possession experiment rests on PROCESS separation -- the runner, the result-integrity node and the adjudication node are separate contexts with separate write scopes, enforced by the graph -- not on cryptography. That was always the design; this finding removes the temptation to treat the crypto as a second line of defence when it is not one. A remediation node is created rather than leaving the criterion silently overstated.

D016_P2B_COORDINATOR_CORROBORATION.ruling: LANDED AND COORDINATOR-CORROBORATED, NOT VERIFIED. An independent verifier still runs before node_passed, at the session model per D015, because coordinator corroboration of three headline numbers is not a review of the full report.
